description:
backend.rs:367 and :470 carry #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]:

  #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
  fn query_calendar_events(
      &self,
      caller: &Self::CallerCtx,
      account_id: &jmap_types::Id,
      filter: Option<&jmap_calendars_types::CalendarEventFilterCondition>,
      sort: Option<&[jmap_calendars_types::CalendarEventComparator]>,
      limit: Option<u64>,
      position: i64,
      args: &CalendarEventQueryArgs,
  ) -> impl Future<...>;     // 7 args including self

  #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
  fn get_availability(
      &self,
      _caller: &Self::CallerCtx,
      _account_id: &jmap_types::Id,
      _principal_id: &jmap_types::Id,
      _utc_start: &jmap_types::UTCDate,
      _utc_end: &jmap_types::UTCDate,
      _show_details: bool,
      _event_properties: Option<&[String]>,
  ) -> impl Future<...>;     // 7 args including self

The crate already uses the args-struct pattern in adjacent surface area: CalendarEventQueryArgs, CalendarEventGetArgs, CalendarEventSetArgs, SetAccumulators (the latter explicitly introduced 'to keep finalize_set_response under clippy's too_many_arguments threshold' per its rustdoc at helpers.rs:21).

The same fix applies here: extend CalendarEventQueryArgs to absorb filter/sort/limit/position (or introduce a dedicated QueryCallArgs struct), and introduce GetAvailabilityArgs for principal_id/utc_start/utc_end/show_details/event_properties.

Lint suppressions ('#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]') are signal noise: clippy fires on too_many_arguments because the function is hard to call correctly (positional args are easy to swap, especially when many are the same type — here, three different &Id values in get_availability). Suppressing the lint silences the warning without fixing the call-site ergonomics.

Same pattern in canonical jmap-mail-server: rg #[allow.too_many_arguments showed the same suppressions on adjacent methods (multi-arg JmapBackend methods). Workspace-wide template-level fix.

Two more findings hide behind this one: JMAP-ic0j.36 (ParseResult::new takes two same-type Vec<Id> positional args — same family of footgun) and the get_availability signature here (utc_start/utc_end both &UTCDate — easy to swap).
title: Two #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] suppressions could be lifted via args-struct pattern already in use
